python.scope: All deep research, reading, PDF table and config tests.

verifiedBehavior: Java forwards both expectedRunRevision and planRevision; Python rejects stale, missing or malformed plan versions on new runs.
A human plan edit does not mutate its incoming payload, widen source policy/budget, or dispatch any model/tool call.
Pinned modern and legacy arXiv identities use exact id_list requests, preserve explicit versions and reject unrelated responses.
Identical actual discovery requests reuse the same settled ledger entry across changed reading questions and repository recreation.
Old pre-verification checkpoint with an old draft is rebased at the plan boundary; saved literal evidence is assessed against new questions first.
Four compiled-graph scenarios cover checkpoint present/missing and relevant/irrelevant evidence; targeted retrieval occurs only when needed.
Superseded draft, repair and coverage outputs remain archived; old verification is not applied to the new plan.
Edited targets enter synthesis/final question context; existing format requirements, source permission and total budgets remain fixed.
Server-owned immutable contracts preserve unmarked historical run routes and request identities.
boundary: Fixed model/transport fixtures validate routing, replay and safeguards. No scientific content or real-provider quality credit. Tests stop at new synthesis input.
stillOpen: Real D1/D2/D3/D5 quality gates and five fresh independent cases.
Actual dependency-driven within-run execution and exact dependency evidence traces have not been established.
Generic incremental references such as second point need authoritative parent/current-user-artifact context binding.
Existing unknown calls remain unresolved and cannot be blindly retried or bypassed by renaming an attempt.
